text: This course is divided into five levels, 10-18 people per class. Students should have 100 hours of Chinese language learning experiences, or had 200-300 Chinese vocabulary. According to the different levels of Chinese skills, set the corresponding Business Chinese courses, including Economic Spoken; Listening; News Reading; International Business Chinese and so on. The course normally takes 2-3 semesters to complete and at the end of the program students would be able to attain higher Chinese proficiency level in business environment. Application Period · April – August 31s fort Fall Semester · October – November 30 for Spring Semester Tuition Fee · Business Chinese: CNY 9,900/person for the first semester, and CNY 9,100/person for each subsequent semester. · Advance payment of CNY 2,000/person, pays in full when confirmation enrollment, will be account into the total tuition fee and is not refundable after the opening of the semester. Certificate · Students who have completed all the courses and passed all the course examinations will be granted a certificate of completion
